en: A vintage black‑and‑white photograph of a traditional wooden windmill standing in an open, flat landscape. The windmill has a tall, tapering body, a circular gallery around its middle, and four long sails. Next to it is a low barn-like building with a gabled roof. The sky is clear and the foreground is grassy terrain. The photo has a white border with slightly scalloped edges, typical of old postcard prints. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.
